sections.extract: arXiv:1409.0902v1 [math.RT] 2 Sep 2014 COCENTERS AND REPRESENT A TIONS OF AFFINE HECKE ALGEBRA DAN CIUBOTARU AND XUHUA HE Abstract. In this paper, we study the relation between the cocenter and the representation theory of aﬃne Hecke algebras.
